Overview · Quick Start · What's New · Features · Clients · Docs · Development

## Overview [WeKnora](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com) is an open-source, LLM-powered knowledge framework for enterprise document understanding, semantic retrieval and reasoning. It brings a team's documents together so they can be searched, reasoned over and kept up to date. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/de0e490a-e738-405e-bb3a-64b63edd7278

v0.9.0 · 2:45 · 1080p60 · English narration and subtitles

Use RAG to look things up, the agent for multi-step tasks, and the wiki to organize knowledge. All three work on the same knowledge bases. **The agent's toolbox.** Skills installed from ClawHub / SkillHub / Git / ZIP run in session-persistent Docker / E2B / Cube sandboxes, with an interactive terminal and graphical desktop beside the chat. Through the BrowserSkill extension the agent operates the user's own Chrome or Edge, and external MCP services (OAuth included) can be connected and enabled tool by tool. Beyond the three modes: - **Memory and curation**: cross-session long-term memory keeps the profile, preferences and facts a user has confirmed. Folder uploads keep their directory tree, and retrieval chunks can be edited, diffed and rolled back. - **Data sources and formats**: auto-sync from Feishu wiki / Feishu Drive / Confluence / GitLab / Tencent IMA / Notion / Yuque / DingTalk Docs / Seafile / RSS, with more on the way. 10+ document formats including PDF, Word, images, Excel and XMind; Office files are parsed in-process by anydoc. - **Channels and integrations**: Q&A in WeCom, Feishu, Slack, Telegram and other IM apps; an embed widget for external websites; a built-in MCP Server for Cursor, Claude and other AI tools; scoped API keys with a principal model for programmatic access. - **Models**: 29 built-in vendors with a generated model catalog, including OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen (Alibaba Cloud), Zhipu, Hunyuan, Gemini, MiniMax, NVIDIA, LiteLLM and Ollama. - **Permissions and operations**: multi-workspace RBAC (four roles, per-resource ownership, per-workspace audit log), several storage instances per workspace, a runtime task-queue dashboard with worker-pool governance, and Langfuse tracing for agent steps, token usage and pipelines. - **Deployment**: LLMs, vector databases and storage backends are all swappable. Deploy locally or on a private cloud and keep the data in your own environment. ## Quick Start

ONLINE
WeChat Dialog Open Platform
Manage knowledge bases online and connect Q&A to Official Accounts, Mini Programs and other WeChat scenarios.

Open the platform →
CLOUD
Tencent Cloud Lighthouse
Deploy WeKnora from an application template and run it on your own cloud server.

Deploy on Tencent Cloud →
SELF-HOSTED
Your own environment
Deploy with Docker or Kubernetes and configure models, storage and networking yourself.

Run with Docker Compose ↓
### Run with Docker Compose Requires [Docker](https://www.docker.com/), [Docker Compose](https://docs.docker.com/compose/) and [Git](https://git-scm.com/). ```bash git clone https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora.git cd WeKnora cp .env.example .env # Edit .env as needed, see comments in the file docker compose pull # Pull the latest images docker compose up -d # Start core services ``` Then open **http://localhost** and follow the onboarding guide. A walkthrough with sample data is in the [Quickstart](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/01-getting-started/03-quickstart). > [!TIP] > To use a local Ollama model, run `ollama serve > /dev/null 2>&1 &` first. For the Ollama embedding model name, `OLLAMA_BASE_URL`, and RAM notes, see [Configuration](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/01-getting-started/04-configuration). | Service | URL | |---------|-----| | Web UI | `http://localhost` | | Backend API | `http://localhost:8080` | | Langfuse Tracing | `http://localhost:3000` | ### Optional services Add `--profile` flags to enable additional components; multiple profiles can be combined. | Profile | Adds | |---------|------| | _(default)_ | Core services | | `full` | All features | | `neo4j` | Knowledge Graph (Neo4j) | | `minio` | Object Storage (MinIO) | | `langfuse` | Tracing (Langfuse) | ```bash docker compose --profile neo4j --profile minio pull docker compose --profile neo4j --profile minio up -d docker compose down # Stop services ``` ### Upgrading If you already have WeKnora running and downloaded a newer release: ```bash # Set WEKNORA_VERSION in .env to the target release (e.g. 0.9.0), or keep latest docker compose pull # Pull images matching WEKNORA_VERSION docker compose up -d # Recreate containers with new images ``` > [!NOTE] > `docker compose up -d` alone reuses locally cached images and may leave the UI version out of sync with the release you downloaded. Read the [upgrade notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0#upgrade-notes) before upgrading. Deployments older than v0.8.2 should also read the [v0.8.2 notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.2#upgrade-notes). ### Other ways to deploy | Option | When to use it | |--------|----------------| | **Docker Compose** | The standard deployment above: all features, multiple services | | **Kubernetes (Helm)** | Production clusters; the chart is in [`helm/`](./helm) | | **Lite single binary** | Local or low-resource use with no external dependencies (SQLite + in-memory queue); see [Lite vs. standard](./docs/LITE.md) | | **Desktop app** | The Lite runtime with a GUI, login-free start and a macOS host sandbox; no installer is published yet, so build it from source | All options, hardware requirements and deployment topologies: [Installation guide](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/01-getting-started/02-installation). > [!WARNING] > WeKnora ships with login authentication, but for production deployments we strongly recommend that you: > - deploy it in an internal / private network rather than on the public internet; > - avoid exposing the service directly to public networks, to prevent information leakage; > - configure proper firewall rules and access controls for the deployment environment; > - regularly update to the latest version for security patches and improvements. ## What's New ### v0.9.0 · 2026-10-29 · [release notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0) - **[WeKnora assistant](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0#assistant)**: Ask about WeKnora releases, features and configuration, then work from the current page: create agents, schedule tasks and manage knowledge, acting as you within your permissions. - **[Multi-agent collaboration](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0#collaboration)**: Delegate independent subtasks, follow progress and bring the results together. - **[Automations](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0#automations)**: Run one-off or recurring tasks with execution history, results and approval notifications. - **[Execution permissions](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0#permissions)**: Read-only, confirm-before-change and automatic-write modes, with scoped session and automation grants. - **[Sandboxes and background work](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0#sandbox)**: Optional per-user sandbox reuse, managed background shell jobs and skill rollout controls. - **[Parsing, sync and retrieval](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0#knowledge)**: Configurable image pipelines, OCR preprocessing, deeper Feishu/Lark sync, Confluence PAT and retrieval improvements. - **[Upgrade notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0#upgrade-notes)**: Review database migrations, Feishu resync, the sandbox allocation gate and configuration changes. ### v0.8.3 · 2026-10-14 · [release notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.3) - **[Image gallery](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.3#images)**: browse document images and filter by source, caption, OCR and image attributes. - **[Multimodal Embedding](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.3#multimodal-embedding)**: support for multimodal embedding models that encode text and images into a shared vector space, including Tencent WeMM-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Embedding, with opt-in image-vector retrieval and compatible image-aware reranking. - **[Wiki graph](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.3#wiki-graph)**: clearer group layouts and theme captions, with group focus, switching and return to the full graph. - **[Source citations](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.3#conversation)**: navigate from an answer to the cited passage in the original document. - **[Chat and tools](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.3#tools)**: on-demand attachment reading without a sandbox, unread replies, @ mention search, Docker terminals, Lite host skills and MCP interoperability updates. - **[Administration and integrations](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.3#administration)**: platform user management, invitation-only signup mode, administrator model catalog, WeMM embeddings, TEI/Pinecone/Cohere reranking, Seafile and Traditional Chinese. - **[Reliability](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.3#other-changes)**: broad retrieval, parsing, datasource, Wiki, OAuth and CLI fixes. Review [upgrade requirements](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.3#upgrade-notes) for registration modes, empty tool lists, database migrations and reindexing. ### v0.8.2 · 2026-09-24 · [release notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.2) Agents can operate the browser on your computer, knowledge bases can be published to other AI tools over MCP, and a running conversation can be steered, forked or rewound. - **[Local Browser (BrowserSkill)](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.2#local-browser)**: agents drive the user's own Chrome / Edge through the open-source BrowserSkill extension, with a live task preview, pause / resume and hand-off for logins and CAPTCHAs. - **[Built-in MCP Server](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.2#mcp-server)**: per-workspace `/mcp/` endpoints over Streamable HTTP, each with its own token, knowledge-base scope, rate limit and tool groups. The Python `mcp-server/` is deprecated. - **[Conversation control](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.2#conversation-control)**: append requirements to a running turn, fork from any earlier question, rewind in place with sandbox checkpoints, and pick reasoning effort per session. Generated files are collected in a new artifacts library. - **[Sandbox](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.2#sandbox)**: interactive terminal and graphical desktop; macOS Lite host sandbox with project folders; a sidebar Toolbox for skills, MCP services and the browser connection. - **[Models](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.2#models)**: rebuilt model catalog (27 built-in vendors with generated context-window, max-output, reasoning and vision metadata). Agent retrieval tools are consolidated into `search_knowledge` / `read_document` / `list_documents`. - **[Knowledge and platform](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.2#knowledge)**: Confluence and DingTalk Docs data sources; Bocha and Serply web search; Japanese UI; per-channel IM reply language; whitelist-only outbound mode. > [!IMPORTANT] > **Breaking:** DingTalk channels are Stream-only, and sandbox commands run as `root`. See the [upgrade notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.2#upgrade-notes). ### v0.8.0 · [release notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.0) - **Skill sandbox runtime**: session-persistent Docker / E2B / Cube backends with per-tenant network policy; the Local host-process backend is removed and Docker is opt-in. - **Tenant skill catalog**: install from ClawHub / SkillHub / git / zip, with per-sandbox snapshots, live progress, file browse/edit, and personal and workspace env vars. - **Cross-session long-term memory**: profile / preference / fact / task / interest, auto-extracted with user confirmation, plus `search_memory`. - **Parsing and sources**: in-process anydoc office parser; GitLab and Tencent IMA data sources; XMind parsing. - **Ecosystem**: official DeepSeek Harness plugin `@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora`; LiteLLM; Exa and Metaso web search. - **Chat**: chat artifacts, question outline and timestamps; context compaction and provider prompt-cache markers. - **Security**: OIDC JWKS verification, optional complex passwords, document auto-tagging, and broad sandbox/security hardening.
Earlier releases (v0.2.0 – v0.7.2)
- **v0.7.2** — Product documentation site; knowledge base folder tree; chunk editing with revision history; wiki page revisions; directly loadable file URLs (`resource_urls=public`); Feishu Drive data source; batch tagging; MCP Server 1.1 (29 tools); AWS S3 default credential chain. - **v0.7.1** — Yunzhijia IM; Volcengine rerank; Zhipu AI web search; platform-scoped API keys; per-KB activity audit; FAQ filtering, tagging and export; See [Tenants & auth](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/01-tenant-auth). - **v0.5.2** — Wiki ingest scales to 40k-document KBs (task queue + DLQ); MCP human-in-the-loop tool approval; Anthropic / Apache Doris / Tencent VectorDB / KS3 / SearXNG backends; Full history: [`CHANGELOG.md`](./CHANGELOG.md).
## Product Tour ### Quick Q&A and smart reasoning **Two ways to ask.** Quick Q&A answers from the knowledge base with RAG and cites the sources it used. In smart reasoning the agent plans multi-step work, searching, reading documents and calling tools and skills, and shows each step in the conversation. [Docs →](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/18-chat-experience) ### Local browser **Operate the browser on your computer.** Through Tencent's open-source BrowserSkill extension, the agent opens pages and fills in forms in your own Chrome or Edge, and hands over to you for logins and CAPTCHAs. [Docs →](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/05-clients/09-local-browser) ### Skills and sandbox **Run skills and produce files.** Docker, E2B and Cube backends are supported. Turns in the same session share one workspace, and generated files can be previewed and downloaded. Open the graphical desktop or interactive terminal beside the chat to follow each step and take over when needed. [Docs →](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/22-skills-sandbox) ### Toolbox: MCP services and skills **Tools the agent can use.** Connect external MCP services and choose, tool by tool, which are enabled and which calls need approval. Install skills from ClawHub, SkillHub, Git or ZIP, manage them per workspace, and reuse them across sandboxes. [Docs →](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/22-skills-sandbox) ### Automatic wiki **Documents organized into a browsable wiki.** With Wiki enabled, WeKnora extracts people, products and concepts from knowledge-base documents into pages with source citations, organized by directory. The knowledge graph shows how pages relate; pages can be edited directly and every change can be rolled back. [Docs →](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/14-wiki) ### Observability **Tracing and runtime monitoring.** Langfuse traces the reasoning, tool calls and token usage of each agent step. The document parsing timeline shows progress stage by stage, and the task-queue dashboard lists queued and failed tasks. [Docs →](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/16-observability) ## Architecture A modular pipeline from document parsing, vectorization and retrieval to LLM inference, in which every component can be replaced or extended. It runs locally or on a private cloud, and the Web UI needs no setup to get started. More: [Architecture overview](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/02-architecture/01-overview) · [RAG pipeline](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/02-architecture/04-rag-pipeline) · [Extension points](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/06-development/03-extension-points). ## Features | Area | Highlights | |------|------------| | [Q&A and agent](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/07-agent) | Quick Q&A answers from knowledge bases with citations; smart reasoning runs a ReAct agent over knowledge bases, web search, MCP tools, skills and the local browser. Steer, fork or rewind a running conversation, and keep [long-term memory](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/23-memory) across sessions | | [Wiki](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/14-wiki) | Agent-generated, interlinked wiki pages with a knowledge graph; in-browser editing, revision diff and rollback | | [Skills and sandbox](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/22-skills-sandbox) | Skill catalog installed from ClawHub / SkillHub / Git / ZIP; session-persistent Docker / E2B / Cube sandboxes with network policy; terminal and graphical desktop beside the chat | | [Knowledge bases](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/02-knowledge-base) | FAQ, document and wiki bases; folder tree; chunk editing with revisions; per-upload parsing, chunking and multimodal settings; auto-tagging | | [Retrieval](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/05-retrieval-engines) | Keyword + vector hybrid search, rerank, parent-child chunking and GraphRAG ([Neo4j](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/09-knowledge-graph)); end-to-end evaluation with recall and BLEU / ROUGE | | [Access and security](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/01-tenant-auth) | Workspace RBAC with four roles and an audit log; scoped API keys; OIDC; AES-256-GCM credential encryption; SSRF-safe outbound requests with a whitelist-only mode | | [Operations](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/16-observability) | Langfuse tracing for agent steps, tokens and pipelines; document parsing timeline; task-queue dashboard with worker pools; automatic migrations on upgrade | ### Supported backends | Component | Options | |-----------|---------| | [LLMs](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/06-models) | 29 built-in vendors, including OpenAI / Azure OpenAI / Anthropic / DeepSeek / Qwen / Zhipu / Hunyuan / Doubao / Gemini / MiniMax / NVIDIA / SiliconFlow / OpenRouter / LiteLLM / Ollama | | Embeddings | Ollama / BGE / GTE / Zhipu / OpenAI-compatible APIs | | Vector databases | PostgreSQL (pgvector + ParadeDB) / Elasticsearch / OpenSearch / Milvus / Weaviate / Qdrant / Apache Doris / Tencent VectorDB | | [Object storage](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/19-storage-backends) | Local / Tencent Cloud COS / MinIO / AWS S3 / Volcengine TOS / Alibaba Cloud OSS / Kingsoft Cloud KS3 / Huawei Cloud OBS | | [Document formats](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/03-document-parsing) | PDF / Word / PPT / Excel / CSV / TXT / Markdown / HTML / EPUB / MHTML / JSON / XMind / images | | [Data sources](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/10-datasource) | Feishu wiki / Feishu Drive / Lark / Confluence / GitLab / Tencent IMA / Notion / Yuque / DingTalk Docs / Seafile / RSS | | [IM channels](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/12-im-integration) | WeCom / Feishu / Lark / QQBot / Slack / Telegram / DingTalk / Mattermost / WeChat / Yunzhijia | | [Web search](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/11-web-search) | DuckDuckGo / Bing / Google / Tavily / Baidu / Ollama / SearXNG / Keenable / Zhipu AI / Exa / Metaso / Bocha / Serply / SearchApi | | Deployment | Docker Compose / Kubernetes (Helm) / Lite single binary / desktop app; offline and private-cloud installs; UI in Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean and Russian | ## Clients and Integrations | | Client | What it does | |:-:|--------|--------------| | | [**CLI `weknora`**](./cli/README.md) | Agent-first command line for the full API, with a curated MCP tool surface and bundled Agent Skills | | | [**Built-in MCP Server**](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/08-mcp) | Publishes knowledge bases to Cursor, Claude and other MCP clients over Streamable HTTP; the Python [`mcp-server/`](./mcp-server/MCP_CONFIG.md) is deprecated | | | [**Local Browser (BrowserSkill)**](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/05-clients/09-local-browser) | Lets agents operate the user's own Chrome / Edge | | | [**Chrome Extension**](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/jpemjbopikggjlmikmclgbmkhhopjdgd) | Select text, images, or entire pages in the browser and save them as knowledge entries with one click, without copy-paste or file upload | | | [**WeChat Mini Program**](./miniprogram/README.md) | Lightweight mobile client: configure API access, select knowledge bases, import URLs, and ask knowledge chat from WeChat | | | [**ClawHub Skill**](https://clawhub.ai/lyingbug/weknora) | A WeKnora skill on ClawHub for document import, hybrid search and knowledge management via the REST API | | | [**DeepSeek Harness plugin**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora) | Gives `dsh` coding agents four read-only tools: search, read document, ask and list knowledge bases | | | [**Website Embed Widget**](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/03-features/13-embed-channel) | Publishes agents on external sites | | | [**Go SDK**](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/05-clients/03-go-sdk) | CRUD for knowledge bases, documents and sessions, plus SSE streaming Q&A | | | [**WeChat Dialog Open Platform**](https://chatbot.weixin.qq.com) | Hosted Q&A built on WeKnora: upload knowledge and publish a Q&A service in WeChat without writing code | ### Command-Line Interface `weknora` is the official CLI for driving the API from a terminal or an AI agent. It is **agent-first**: every command emits a stable JSON envelope by default (with typed error codes mapped to exit codes), and `--format text` renders for humans. It also serves a curated MCP tool surface (`weknora mcp serve`) and ships bundled Agent Skills. ```bash weknora profile add prod --host https://kb.example.com --use weknora auth login weknora kb list weknora link --kb my-knowledge-base # bind the current directory weknora doc upload notes.md weknora chat "summarise the design doc" ``` For headless / CI use, set `WEKNORA_API_KEY` + `WEKNORA_HOST` and skip `auth login`; no credentials are written to disk. See [`cli/README.md`](./cli/README.md) for install + 5-minute quickstart and [`cli/AGENTS.md`](./cli/AGENTS.md) for the operational contract AI agents rely on. ## Documentation The full product documentation lives at **[weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/)** (in Chinese), organized as Getting Started → Architecture → Features → API → Clients → Development and covering ~360 API endpoints and ~150 environment variables. | Start here | | |------------|---| | [Introduction](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/01-getting-started/01-introduction) | Capabilities overview | | [Installation](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/01-getting-started/02-installation) | Docker Compose, Helm, Lite and desktop | | [Configuration](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/01-getting-started/04-configuration) | Environment variables and models | | [Troubleshooting FAQ](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/01-getting-started/05-troubleshooting) | Common problems and fixes | | [API reference](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/04-api/01-api-overview) | REST API overview | | [Release notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0) | What changed in each release | ## Development If you need to frequently modify code, you don't need to rebuild Docker images every time. Use fast development mode: ```bash make dev-start # Start infrastructure make dev-app # Start backend (new terminal) make dev-frontend # Start frontend (new terminal) ``` - Frontend modifications auto hot-reload (no restart needed) - Backend modifications quick restart (5-10 seconds, supports Air hot-reload) - No need to rebuild Docker images - Supports IDE breakpoint debugging See the [Development guide](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/06-development/01-dev-guide) for details. The documentation site and product homepage are built from [`website-docs/`](./website-docs/README.md). With Node.js 24, run `cd website-docs && npm run setup && npm run build && npm run preview` to preview both together; the unified static output serves the homepage at `/` and documentation at `/docs/`. See the directory's README for Nginx and Docker deployment. ## Contributing Welcome to submit [Issues](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/issues) or Pull Requests. - **Process:** Fork → Create branch → Commit changes → Open PR - **Standards:** Format code with `gofmt`, follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:` / `fix:` / `docs:` / `test:` / `refactor:`)
Validating your change
For a focused PR, validate the changed scope first: ```bash git fetch origin main git diff --check origin/main...HEAD golangci-lint run --new-from-rev=origin/main ./... go test ./path/to/changed/package -count=1 ``` Run `gofmt` on changed Go files before committing. For frontend changes, run the relevant tests from `frontend/` and use `npm run type-check` when the change affects TypeScript or Vue components. The full maintainer gate remains: ```bash make fmt make lint make test ``` `make fmt` formats the entire Go repository, so run it only with a clean worktree and review the resulting diff. Some full-suite tests require local infrastructure or service configuration. If a full check fails for an unrelated baseline or environment reason, include the exact command and failure in the PR while still providing passing targeted tests for your change.
### Contributors Thanks to everyone who has contributed: [![Contributors](https://contrib.rocks/image?repo=Tencent/WeKnora)](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/graphs/contributors) ## License This project is licensed under the [MIT License](./LICENSE). You are free to use, modify, and distribute the code with proper attribution.

repositories.name: pstack-claude
repositories.description: Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Muse, OpenCode, Pi, and Prime Agent versions of Poteto's pstack. Rigorous agent workflows with Cursor primitives translated for other harnesses.
repositories.readme:
# pstack [![Buy Me A Coffee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Buy%20Me%20A%20Coffee-support-yellow?logo=buy-me-a-coffee&logoColor=white)](https://buymeacoffee.com/codenyer) [![Mentioned in Awesome Claude Code](https://awesome.re/mentioned-badge.svg)](https://github.com/hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code) Lauren Tan's [pstack](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack) is an opinionated Cursor skill stack that improves agent outcomes. This is a port for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, GitHub Copilot, Muse, and other agent harnesses. It tracks upstream and also carries named policy forks, each declared in [`tools/forks.json`](tools/forks.json). Tell `poteto-mode` your goal and it will invoke the correct workflow for the task. It keeps your code concise, simple and verified. For concurrency bugs and invariants that tests cannot reach, `/create-formal-verification-skill` picks the riskiest property in your code, verifies it with a tool that fits, and leaves a project skill the next agent reruns. The separate [agent-formal-verify](https://github.com/michael-denyer/agent-formal-verify) plugin goes deeper on the method, with guided TLA+ model checking, Lean proofs, and Kani for Rust. ## Built for Claude Code This port translates upstream's Cursor skills for Claude Code before installation. [Upstream's Claude Code install](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/c742dd6/harness/pstack/claude-code) asks agents to translate Cursor names at runtime, using extra tokens and relying on them to apply the mapping correctly. This port also adds a SessionStart hook that routes tasks to `poteto-mode`. ## Install
Claude Code Run in Claude Code 2.1.292 or later: ```text /plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/pstack-claude /plugin install pstack@pstack-claude ``` Claude Code leaves auto-update off for third-party marketplaces, so pstack stays on the version you installed. To turn it on, run `/plugin`, open the **Marketplaces** tab, select `pstack-claude`, and choose **Enable auto-update**. To update once by hand, run `claude plugin update pstack@pstack-claude`.
Codex Run in your terminal: ```shell codex plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/pstack-claude codex plugin add pstack@pstack-claude ``` Invoke a skill by typing `$` and its name, such as `$poteto-mode` or `$babysit`, then choosing its entry, which inserts `$pstack:`. `/skills` lists every skill.
Pi Run in your terminal: ```shell pi install git:github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude ``` The package loads the skills and the pstack Pi extension, which adds the subagent, question, and wake-up tools the skills use, plus `/loop` and the routing instruction. Invoke a skill with `/skill:`.
GitHub Copilot Run in your terminal: ```shell copilot plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/pstack-claude copilot plugin install pstack@pstack-claude ``` This installs pstack for the Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app, which share `~/.copilot`. Start a new session afterwards. Copilot ships no default pstack models, so the first skill that needs one runs `setup-pstack` to pick from the models your account lists, and later sessions reuse that choice. The Copilot build is tested on Copilot CLI 1.0.87 through 1.0.92. On those versions the routing hook's context reaches the session alongside other plugins' session-start context. If a later version keeps only one plugin's context, `setup-pstack` offers a [standing instruction](plugins/pstack/skills/setup-pstack/copilot.md#wire-it-in) for `~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md` instead. On 1.0.92, once the CLI caches its computer-use experiment assignment, `copilot -p` sessions list no plugin skills and a `skill` call returns "Skill not found". Interactive sessions, the hooks, and the agents are unaffected.
Muse Run in your terminal: ```shell git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude muse plugins install ./plugins/pstack muse plugins approve pstack ``` The first command installs the native Muse plugin bundle. The second approves its `SessionStart` hook and agent definitions, which Muse runs only after approval. Start a new session afterwards. Invoke a skill with `/` (for example `/poteto-mode`), which Muse lists for each user-invocable skill.
Kimi Code CLI After a release containing `kimi.plugin.json` is published, close other Kimi sessions and install it in a fresh Kimi Code CLI session: ```text /plugins install https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude /reload ``` To test an unreleased checkout, use `/plugins install /absolute/path/to/pstack-claude` instead, followed by `/reload`; Kimi copies the whole checkout, including Git metadata and local files, so use a clean, reviewed copy. To update, close other Kimi sessions, reinstall from the same source in a fresh session, and run `/reload`. Invoke a skill as `/skill:pstack:poteto-mode`; see the [Kimi mapping](plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/references/kimi-tools.md) for tool guidance.
Grok Build ```shell git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude grok plugin install "$PWD/plugins/pstack" --trust grok plugin enable pstack ``` Start a new session and use `/poteto-mode` to load the skill explicitly. To update a local install, quit Grok sessions, inspect `grok plugin details pstack` and back up any edits in the installed copy, pull the checkout, run `grok plugin uninstall pstack --keep-data`, and repeat the last two commands. If pstack was disabled, disable it again before restarting. `grok plugin update` does not refresh a local install.
MiniMax Code Run in your terminal: ```shell git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude mkdir -p "${MINIMAX_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.minimax}/plugins" cp -R plugins/pstack "${MINIMAX_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.minimax}/plugins/pstack" ``` MiniMax Code loads each directory under `plugins/` in its data directory as a local plugin, and reads pstack through its Claude Code reader with the skills, agents, and routing hook. `mcode plugin list` shows it as `pstack@local`. To update after a `git pull`, delete the old `plugins/pstack` copy first, then run the `cp` line again; copying onto an existing copy nests it inside.
Antigravity (agy) Run in your terminal: ```shell git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude agy plugin install ./plugins/pstack ``` This installs the native Antigravity plugin bundle (`skills`, `agents`, and `SessionStart` routing hook) into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/pstack`.
Other harnesses OpenCode (the CLI and the desktop app), Gemini CLI, Prime Agent, and skills-only Codex installs read skills from `~/.agents/skills/`. Run in your terminal: ```shell git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills for s in plugins/pstack/skills/*/; do target=~/.agents/skills/"$(basename "$s")" test -e "$target" || test -L "$target" || ln -s "$(pwd)/$s" "$target" done ``` To update, run `git pull` in the clone, then run the `for` loop again to link skills added since the last run. These installs have no routing hook, so ask for `poteto-mode` by name or add a standing instruction to the harness's instruction file. See [shared installation](docs/reference.md#shared-skills-installation) for per-harness notes and uninstalling.
### Configure pstack routes tasks to `poteto-mode` automatically. At session start, a hook injects an instruction that points the agent at it: the plugin's hook on Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Muse, and MiniMax Code, and the pstack extension on Pi. Codex runs the hook only after you trust it through `/hooks`, and Muse only after `muse plugins approve pstack`. Other harnesses have no hook. Run `setup-pstack` to turn automatic routing on or off, change model defaults, or set a reasoning effort per role (`arena runners: opus @xhigh, fable @max`). ## Getting started ```text Use poteto-mode to fix the search filter resetting when I change pages. ``` For a bug, it reproduces the failure, uses `how` and `why` to investigate, delegates the fix, then reruns the failing case. If the fix crosses a function boundary, it brings in `architect` before implementation. You receive the fix and the failing and passing evidence. [Other playbooks](plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md#playbooks) cover planning, features, refactoring, performance issues, investigations, prototypes, PR maintenance, shipping, and longer projects. ![poteto-mode on Claude Code, Codex, and Pi turns a request into verified work. Choose a playbook, plan and delegate with architect, arena, or swarm, then review and verify with interrogate, tests, and measurements. Project playbooks customize the workflow, and setup-pstack configures the model and reasoning effort per role. Supporting skills include how, why, and unslop.](assets/pstack-overview.png) ## Details - [Skills and slash commands](docs/reference.md#slash-commands) - [Runtime setup](docs/reference.md#runtime-support) - [Models and dependencies](docs/reference.md#configuration-and-dependencies) - [Maintenance and port scope](docs/reference.md#maintenance) ## Data handling pstack has no server or telemetry. Anything its skills ask your agent to read, including session transcripts, goes to your model provider. Scripts run locally, and PR tools use your GitHub CLI login. ## Contributing Thanks for helping make this port better. Bug reports, documentation fixes, and runtime improvements are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the checks and where your change belongs. Report vulnerabilities privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). To support maintenance of this port, [buy the maintainer a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/codenyer). ## License This port, including its modifications and additions, is also [MIT-licensed](LICENSE), © 2026 Michael Denyer. Original pstack © 2026 Lauren Tan; imported cursor-team-kit and thermos skills © 2026 Cursor. See [LICENSE-cursor-team-kit](LICENSE-cursor-team-kit), [LICENSE-thermos](LICENSE-thermos), and [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

repositories.name: go-music-dl
repositories.description: 一个基于 Go 语言的全网音乐搜索与下载工具。支持 CLI 命令行与 Web 服务双模式，内置网易云、QQ、酷狗、Bilibili、汽水音乐等 10+ 个主流平台，支持多源并发搜索与无损音质解析。music-dl交流群：755087923
repositories.readme:
# Go Music DL > ⭐ 如果这个项目对你有帮助，欢迎点一个 Star。

Go Music DL 是一个多平台音乐搜索与下载工具，支持 **Web**、**TUI** 和**桌面端**，覆盖单曲、歌单、专辑、排行榜与本地音乐。它同时暴露了一套 AI 可调用的接口——**AI 可以直接操控你正开着的网页播放器**，点歌、切歌、暂停、调音量都不用你动手，详见 [AI / Agent 调用](#ai--agent-调用)。 ## 🚀 快速开始 ### 桌面端 / 移动端 从 [Releases](https://github.com/guohuiyuan/go-music-dl/releases) 下载对应安装包： - Windows / Linux / macOS：从 Releases 下载 `music-dl-desktop-rust` 或 `music-dl-desktop-go` 对应平台包，解压后直接运行。 - Android：优先下载 `music-dl_arm64-v8a.apk`，已内置 FFmpeg，无需额外安装。 - iOS：使用 `music-dl-ios-unsigned.ipa` 自行签名。 ### Web / TUI ```bash # Web，默认访问 http://localhost:8080/music ./music-dl web # 挂载到反向代理二级目录 ./music-dl web --base-path /dl # 终端搜索 ./music-dl -k "周杰伦" ``` Web 的搜索、试听、下载和歌单浏览无需登录；修改设置或 Cookie 时才需要管理员账号。首次配置时，启动日志会打印 `Web setup token`，用它创建管理员账号即可。TUI 常用键：`↑/↓` 移动、`空格` 选择、`a` 全选、`r` 换源、`Enter` 下载、`w` 每日推荐、`q` 退出。 ### Docker ```bash docker compose up -d --pull always --remove-orphans ``` 访问 `http://localhost:8080`。首次启动会自动创建 `./data` 并配置好容器写权限；Compose 不依赖仓库里的 Dockerfile 或其他文件，只需 `docker-compose.yml` 和镜像即可启动。修改源码后可使用 `docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build` 本地构建。 ### AI / Agent 调用 Web 服务提供 AI 能力索引和播放器控制接口。搜索、歌单、专辑、排行榜、歌单分类、换源、歌词、下载和本地音乐等能力全部复用现有的 `/music/*` 接口，不再维护第二套 AI 包装路由。 ```bash # 搜索歌曲，只请求 QQ 和网易云 curl "http://localhost:8080/music/search?q=周杰伦&type=song&sources=qq&sources=netease" ``` API 索引：`http://localhost:8080/music/api/ai/index`，精简说明：`http://localhost:8080/music/llms.txt`。索引会列出可直接复用的现有搜索、详情、排行榜、歌单分类、换源、下载和本地音乐接口，以及新增的播放器控制接口。 #### AI 可以直接操控网页播放器 只要浏览器里开着本站页面，AI 就能**远程操作这个页面**：点歌、切歌、暂停、调音量、拖动进度，全部靠一条 HTTP 请求完成。不需要浏览器自动化、不需要模拟点击、也不需要接管你的鼠标键盘。 原理是页面自己维持着一条 SSE 长连接（`GET /music/api/ai/player/events`）：AI 把命令 POST 到服务端，服务端推给在线的页面，页面执行后把播放状态回传。所以 AI 看到的 `playing`、`position`、`current` 都是页面的真实状态，而不是猜测。 典型对话：**“帮我放一首 ClariS 的歌”** → AI 调 `/music/search` 找歌 → 调 `/api/ai/player/play` 点播 → 轮询 `/api/ai/player/state` 确认已经在放。 ```bash # 1. 看看当前有哪些播放器在线、在放什么 curl "http://localhost:8080/music/api/ai/player/state" # 2. 直接点播（用 id + source，或只给 query 让服务端自己搜第一首） curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/music/api/ai/player/play" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest" \ -d '{"id":"1958384591","source":"netease","name":"ALIVE","artist":"ClariS"}' # 3. 传输控制 curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/music/api/ai/player/command" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest" \ -d '{"action":"pause"}' ``` `/api/ai/player/command` 支持 `play`、`pause`、`toggle`、`stop`、`next`、`previous`、`seek`、`volume` 和 `rate`。没有已打开的播放器时会返回 `409 player_not_connected`。 #### 多客户端：各控各的 每个打开的页面（标签页、桌面端、另一台设备）都是独立客户端，**状态互不覆盖，命令互不串台**： * 连接时带 `?client_id=xxx` 声明身份；老页面匿名连上来后，第一次上报状态时会被自动认领。 * `POST /play` 和 `/command` 带 `client_id` 就只投给那一台；只有 1 台在线时自动定向，一条 curl 照样能用。 * **多台在线又不带 `client_id`** → 返回 `409 ambiguous_client` 和候选列表，绝不并发让所有页面一起切歌。 * `GET /state` 不带参数时优先选择在线、正在播放、页面可见的客户端，同类按连接顺序稳定选择，不会被 2 秒一次的状态上报带着来回跳；`GET /state?client_id=xxx` 精确读取某一台。 * 每台客户端分别保存 `last_command`，查询某台不会混入其他客户端的命令。 * 页面关掉后不会立刻消失，而是标记 `connected:false` 并保留最后状态 10 分钟；定向投给它返回 `409 client_not_connected`。 * 在线事件流最多 64 个；命令通道写满时返回 `503 player_busy`，不会假装投递成功。 **使用前提：** 页面必须处于打开状态（后台标签页也能收命令，但浏览器会节流定时器，进度上报会变慢）；升级后请 `Ctrl+F5` 硬刷新，`app.js` 是编译进二进制的，旧页面用不了 `client_id` 定向。这套接口默认无鉴权，仅靠 `X-Requested-With` 做 CSRF 防护，**请勿把服务直接暴露到公网**；远程使用请走 SSH 隧道或放在反向代理的鉴权后面。 --- ![Web UI 1](./screenshots/web1.png) ![Web UI 2](./screenshots/web2.png) ![TUI 1](./screenshots/tui1.png) ![TUI 2](./screenshots/tui2.png) ## 主要功能 * **多端使用**：Web、TUI 终端和原生桌面应用，桌面端自动启动内置服务。 * **搜索与下载**：多平台聚合搜索单曲、歌单和专辑，支持试听、批量下载、换源和无损音频。 * **歌单管理**：浏览官方分类、个人歌单和排行榜，也可创建本地歌单并跨平台收藏歌曲。 * **登录能力**：支持 Cookie 与扫码登录，用于个人歌单、更高音质和部分受限资源。 * **本地音乐**：扫描、上传、搜索和整理本地音频，自动读取元数据、封面与歌词。 * **播放体验**：支持逐字歌词、歌词字体、全局快捷键、媒体键和播放缓存。 * **AI 操控网页**：AI 可通过 HTTP 接口直接控制已打开的网页播放器（点歌、切歌、暂停、音量、进度），多客户端各自独立，详见 [AI 可以直接操控网页播放器](#ai-可以直接操控网页播放器)。 ## 歌单 / 专辑支持 Web 与 TUI 都支持单曲、歌单、专辑三种搜索类型；粘贴歌单或专辑链接会自动识别来源并进入详情。曲目列表支持播放、下载、批量操作和导入本地歌单。 渠道覆盖网易云、QQ、酷狗、酷我、咪咕、汽水、Apple Music、Bilibili、Jamendo、JOOX 和千千等，实际可用来源以界面列表为准。 ## 歌单分类与我的歌单 * **歌单分类**：支持网易云、QQ、酷狗、酷我、咪咕、千千、JOOX、汽水和 Apple Music；汽水提供每日推荐、流行、华语、欧美、国风等分类。 * **我的歌单**：登录或配置 Cookie 后，可读取网易云、QQ、酷狗和汽水的个人歌单、收藏及喜欢的歌曲。 * **站内处理**：分类歌单和个人歌单均可查看详情、播放、下载、批量操作或导入本地歌单。 ## 排行榜 首页“排行榜”聚合网易云、QQ、酷狗、酷我、咪咕、汽水和 Apple Music 的官方榜单。各平台的“热门单曲”对应当地热歌榜，榜单歌曲可直接播放、下载和批量处理。 QQ 下载需要有效 Cookie；汽水支持 Cookie + 签名获取会员整曲，签名不可用时自动回退到公开试听片段。 ## Cookie 与扫码登录 设置页可管理各平台 Cookie，并提供手动抓取步骤和请求域名。网易云、QQ、酷狗和 Bilibili 支持扫码登录，成功后自动保存 Cookie。 汽水音乐扫码暂不可用，需要手动配置 Cookie；会员整曲优先使用 music-lib 内置的本机签名器，也可配置可信的远程签名服务。Cookie 仅保存在本地数据目录，请勿公开分享配置文件。 ## 本地音乐 默认读取 `data/downloads`，Android 建议使用 `/sdcard/Music`。支持 `mp3`、`flac`、`m4a`、`ogg`、`wav`、`wma` 和 `aac`。 * **导入与识别**：支持上传；优先读取内嵌元数据、封面和歌词，缺失时查找同名资源并用 `ffprobe` 补全。 * **搜索与整理**：本地音乐可作为 `local` 搜索源，支持分页、扫描快照、元数据缓存、后台刷新和 SQLite 索引。 * **歌单操作**：支持批量收藏到自制歌单；删除本地文件需要二次确认，已收藏条目可保留并换源恢复。 * **文件命名**：设置页支持 `{name}`、`{artist}`、`{album}`、`{source}`、`{id}`、`{ext}` 等文件名模板。 ## 下载与同步 下载默认走流式模式，支持 `Range` 断点和拖动播放。设置页可按需开启： * 下载时内嵌封面和歌词，依赖 `ffmpeg`；缺失时自动跳过，不影响原始音频下载。 * 可选择在音频文件同目录生成同名标准 LRC，不改动已有歌词文件；也可单独点击歌词按钮保存。 * 下载时同步到 WebDAV，可填写地址、账号、密码和远端目录。 FFmpeg 与 `ffprobe` 用于本地音乐探测和元数据写入。Docker 镜像和 Android APK 已内置；CLI、桌面和 iOS 包如需这些能力，请自行安装。可用 `ffmpeg -version` 检查。 ## 新增改动（简要） * **排行榜与歌单**：聚合各平台榜单和热门单曲，补齐分类歌单、我的歌单、链接解析及批量操作。 * **播放与歌词**：新增底部播放器、换源、逐字歌词、歌词字体、全局快捷键、媒体键和任务栏缩略图控制。 * **搜索过滤**：支持屏蔽 Live / Remix / Demo 等版本和 60 秒以下试听，并统一简繁体及零宽字符。 * 可直接点播并操控已打开的网页；多客户端按 `client_id` 隔离，命令定向投递、状态分槽存储，多标签页互不干扰。 * **桌面与移动端**：增加应用设置、歌词字体、圆角图标，Android 支持蓝牙媒体键和内置 FFmpeg。 ## CLI/TUI 常用命令 ```bash # 搜索 ./music-dl -k "周杰伦" ``` TUI 常用按键： * `↑/↓` 移动 * `空格` 选择 * `a` 全选/清空 * `r` 对勾选项换源 * `Enter` 下载 * `b` 返回 * `w` 每日推荐歌单 * `q` 退出 更多用法： ```bash # 查看帮助 ./music-dl -h # 指定搜索源 ./music-dl -k "周杰伦 晴天" -s qq,netease # 指定下载目录 ./music-dl -k "周杰伦" -o ./my_music # 下载时包含封面和歌词 ./music-dl -k "周杰伦" --cover --lyrics ``` ## GitHub Actions 自动构建 本项目已配置 GitHub Actions 工作流。当推送代码并打上版本标签（如 `v1.0.0`）时，会自动触发 `.github/workflows/docker.yml`，构建跨平台镜像（支持 amd64 和 arm64）并推送到 DockerHub。 ### Android APK 构建 项目支持通过 Gio 打包 Android APK，输出文件为仓库根目录下的三个 APK： * `music-dl_arm64-v8a.apk`（推荐，大多数 Android 设备） * `music-dl_x86_64.apk`（x86_64 设备/模拟器） * `music-dl.apk`（无分片兼容包，极个别设备无法使用分片包时再下载） 安装 Android APK 后，建议在 Web 右上角“设置”中把“本地下载目录”改为 `/sdcard/Music`，这样下载文件会直接进入系统音乐目录。 #### 1. 本地构建 APK（Windows） 前置条件： * Go 已安装并可用（建议 1.25+） * JDK（推荐 17） * Android SDK 已安装，默认路径 `C:\Android` * 可用的 NDK（脚本会自动尝试安装 `27.0.12077973`） 执行命令： ```bat cd go-music-dl package_app.bat ``` 脚本会自动： * 读取当前 Java 环境（`JAVA_HOME` / `java`） * 检测/安装 Android NDK * 安装 `gogio` * 构建 `music-dl_arm64-v8a.apk`、`music-dl_x86_64.apk`、`music-dl.apk` 若检测到 adb，会打印安装命令，例如： ```bat adb install -r music-dl.apk ``` #### 2. Release 流程自动构建 APK `.github/workflows/release.yml` 中新增了 `build-android-apk` 任务。发布时会在 `windows-latest` 环境中： * 安装 Go、JDK 17、Android SDK * 安装 `platform-tools`、`platforms;android-33`、`build-tools;34.0.0`、`ndk;27.0.12077973` * 下载 Android `arm` / `arm64` / `x86` / `x86_64` 的 `ffmpeg` 与 `ffprobe` * 执行 `package_app.bat` * 构建 APK 后注入 `assets/ffmpeg//ffmpeg` 与 `assets/ffmpeg//ffprobe`，重新 `zipalign` 并用发布 keystore 签名 * 校验三个 APK 都包含对应 ABI 的 `ffmpeg/ffprobe`，不包含旧的 `libffmpeg.so/libffprobe.so` 条目，且签名有效 * 上传 `music-dl_arm64-v8a.apk`、`music-dl_x86_64.apk`、`music-dl.apk` 到 Actions Artifacts 和 GitHub Release 发布后可在 [Releases](https://github.com/guohuiyuan/go-music-dl/releases) 下载三个 APK，推荐优先使用 `music-dl_arm64-v8a.apk`；极个别设备若无法安装/运行，再下载 `music-dl.apk`（无分片兼容包）。 #### 3. Java 17 与 Build-Tools 版本说明（重点） 高版本（`34.0.0` 及以上）的 Android Build-Tools 已修复旧版 `d8.bat` 脚本兼容性问题，可正常配合 Java 17 使用。 如果本地仍有 `33.0.0`，建议升级并清理旧版本： ```cmd "C:\Android\cmdline-tools\latest\bin\sdkmanager.bat" "build-tools;34.0.0" ``` 如果你使用 Android Studio，也可以在 SDK Manager -> SDK Tools 中勾选 Show Package Details，然后安装 `34.0.0` 及以上版本。 非常关键：请到 `C:\Android\build-tools\` 目录下，删除或重命名 `33.0.0` 旧目录，避免 `gogio` 优先命中旧版 `d8`。 完成后再次执行： ```bat cd go-music-dl package_app.bat ``` ### iOS App 构建 项目已提供 iOS 打包脚本：`package_ios.sh`。 #### 1. 构建环境 * macOS（需安装 Xcode Command Line Tools） * Go 已安装并可用 * 可用的 iOS provisioning profile 与对应签名证书 #### 2. 执行构建 ```bash cd go-music-dl chmod +x package_ios.sh export IOS_APP_ID=com.guohuiyuan.musicdl export IOS_PROVISION_PROFILE=/path/to/profile.mobileprovision ./package_ios.sh # 只生成给用户自行签名的包 IOS_UNSIGNED_ONLY=1 ./package_ios.sh ``` 脚本会自动： * 安装 `gogio` * 使用 provisioning profile 打包为真机 IPA（输出 `music-dl-ios.ipa`） * 或使用 `IOS_UNSIGNED_ONLY=1` 生成真机架构的待签名包（输出 `music-dl-ios-unsigned.ipa`） #### 3. 产物说明 * `music-dl-ios.ipa`：已签名真机安装包，需要 `IOS_PROVISION_PROFILE` 指向匹配 `IOS_APP_ID` 的 `.mobileprovision` * `music-dl-ios-unsigned.ipa`：真机架构待签名包，仅用于用户自行重签，不能直接安装 发布后可在 [Releases](https://github.com/guohuiyuan/go-music-dl/releases) 下载 `music-dl-ios-unsigned.ipa`；配置签名 secrets 后也会上传 `music-dl-ios.ipa`。 > 注意：`music-dl-ios-unsigned.ipa` 不是可直接安装包，需要用户用自己的证书和 provisioning profile 重签。如果需要 GitHub Actions 自动发布已签名 iOS 包，需要配置 `IOS_PROVISION_PROFILE_BASE64`、`IOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64` 和 `IOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD`。 #### 4. iOS 白屏或启动后终止排查 发布页同时提供对应 IPA 的 `.sha256` 文件，先确认下载和重签的不是损坏包。网页播放器、图标和 Sakana 组件均已内置到 IPA，不再依赖 jsDelivr；iOS 包还启用了本地网络和 WebView HTTP 兼容配置。如果启动页连续 5 次仍未收到 WebView 桥接确认，会显示包含目标地址、运行环境和最后状态的诊断页，不再无限重载。 LiveContainer 提示 “App returned from its main function with code 0” 时，请按以下顺序排除： 1. 用 SideStore、AltStore 或其他签名工具把**同一个已重签 IPA**直接安装并启动。 2. 如果直接侧载提示 “This app is in an invalid format”，优先检查 IPA 是否完整、重签证书和 provisioning profile 是否匹配，而不是排查页面代码。 3. 如果直接侧载正常、只有 LiveContainer 终止，请附上 LiveContainer 版本、iOS 版本，以及“设置 → 隐私与安全 → 分析与改进 → 分析数据”中对应应用的崩溃报告。 LiveContainer 的官方排查说明见 [App crashes](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/faq/app-crashes)。仅凭“启动即终止”且没有崩溃报告，无法判断是重签包还是容器兼容问题。 **如果你 Fork 了本仓库并希望使用自己的构建流：** 1. 在你的仓库 **Settings** -> **Secrets and variables** -> **Actions** 中添加： * `DOCKERHUB_USERNAME`: 你的 DockerHub 用户名 * `DOCKERHUB_TOKEN`: 你的 DockerHub 访问令牌 2. 将 `docker-compose.yml` 中的镜像地址修改为你自己的：`image: 你的用户名/go-music-dl:latest` ## Web 换源说明 单曲卡片里的“换源”会在其它平台里找更像的版本： * 桌面应用打不开或显示空白？** 检查是否已安装 WebView2 运行时。从 [Microsoft官网](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/) 下载安装最新版本。 **Q: 桌面应用启动慢或卡顿？** 首次运行需要下载 WebView2 运行时。也可提前安装 Evergreen Bootstrapper 版本。 **Q: 桌面应用启动时提示"另一个程序正在使用此文件"？** 这是因为上一次运行的后台进程没有正常退出。解决方案： ```powershell # 强制结束残留进程 taskkill /F /IM music-dl.exe ``` **Q: 如何构建桌面应用？** 构建 Rust 桌面应用 ```bash # 1. 构建 Go 二进制 go build -o desktop/music-dl.exe cmd/music-dl/main.go # 2. 构建 Rust 桌面应用 cd desktop cargo build --release ``` 构建纯 Go 的桌面应用 ``` cd desktop # Windows go build -ldflags="-H windowsgui" # Linux go build ``` **Q: 桌面应用支持哪些平台？** 目前支持 Windows (x64/x86/arm64)、macOS (x64/arm64)、Linux (x64)。 ### 通用问题 **Q: 有些歌搜不到或下载失败？** 可能是付费限制、平台接口变更或网络问题。 **Q: Web 模式打不开？** 检查端口是否占用，或浏览器插件是否拦截。 **Q: AI 帮我点了歌，但网页没反应？** 按顺序排查：① 页面是否还开着（关掉后返回 `409 player_not_connected`）；② 多标签页在线时是否漏了 `client_id`（返回 `409 ambiguous_client`，响应里带候选列表）；③ 是否升级后没硬刷新，旧页面的 `app.js` 不会带 `client_id`，可以先用不带 `client_id` 的单客户端方式验证；④ 是否返回 `503 player_busy`，这表示目标页面暂时没消费完命令队列，稍后重试即可；⑤ 曲目本身能否取流——换源或配好对应平台 Cookie 再试。 **Q: 如何设置 Cookie 获取更高音质？** Web 右上角“设置”里可添加平台 Cookie。网易云音乐、QQ 音乐、酷狗音乐、Bilibili 支持点击输入框右侧的“扫码”按钮登录，扫码成功后会自动保存 Cookie。汽水音乐新版扫码登录暂未调通，入口已临时隐藏，请先手动配置 Cookie；汽水音乐会员曲目想要下载整曲，默认用内置的“本机签名器”（装过汽水官方客户端即自动可用，无需额外服务）。客户端不在默认位置时，可在“汽水音乐安装目录”中填写包含 `SodaMusic.exe` 和 `bdms.node` 的版本目录；也可以设置 `QISHUI_CLIENT_DIR`，环境变量优先。“汽水音乐整曲取流”里的签名服务地址留空即可；如果要在别的机器上跑签名服务，再填上那边的地址与 Token。 **Q: 如何查看歌单分类和我的歌单？** Web 首页歌单入口旁提供“歌单分类”和“我的歌单”。歌单分类可直接浏览支持平台的官方分类，其中汽水音乐提供发现页的 13 个推荐分类（每个分类会聚合多轮随机推荐并去重）；我的歌单需要先配置对应平台 Cookie，目前支持网易云音乐、QQ 音乐、酷狗音乐和汽水音乐。 **Q: 开启“内嵌元数据”后没生效？** 先确认系统已安装 FFmpeg 且 `ffmpeg -version` 可执行；若不可用，程序会降级为原始音频下载（不内嵌封面/歌词）。 **Q: 桌面版的数据保存在哪里？** `desktop_go` 会忽略启动时的工作目录，统一使用系统用户配置目录下的 `music-dl`：设置数据库为 `music-dl/data/settings.db`，Cookie 和默认下载目录也在该数据目录中。macOS 从 Finder 双击启动、Windows 从安装目录启动时都不会再尝试写入只读的当前目录。 ### Windows 任务栏缩略图工具栏 Windows 版的 `music-dl-desktop-go.exe` 与 `music-dl-desktop-rust.exe` 均提供任务栏缩略图工具栏。把鼠标移到任务栏图标上即可使用“上一首”“播放/暂停”“下一首”，无需还原或放大播放器窗口。当前没有可播放歌曲时按钮会禁用，播放状态会自动同步为播放或暂停图标。 ## 项目结构 ```text go-music-dl/ ├── cmd/ │ └── music-dl/ # CLI/TUI 主程序 ├── core/ # 核心业务逻辑 ├── internal/ │ ├── cli/ # TUI 界面 (如: ui.go) │ └── web/ # 重构后的 Web 后端服务 │ ├── templates/ # 前端模板与静态资源分离 │ ├── server.go # Web 服务主入口 │ ├── music.go # 音乐搜索与解析路由 │ ├── collection.go # 本地自制歌单接口 (GORM) │ ├── local_music.go # 本地音乐扫描、上传、封面/歌词与删除接口 │ └── videogen.go # 视频生成后端支持 ├── desktop/ # 桌面应用 (Rust + Tao/Wry) ├── desktop_go/ # 桌面应用 (Go + webview2 ) ├── desktop_app/ # 移动应用 (Go + Gio ) ├── data/ # 数据目录，Docker 首次启动时自动创建 │ ├── downloads/ # 下载的音乐文件 │ ├── video_output/ # 生成的视频文件 │ ├── cookies.json # Cookie 配置文件 │ └── settings.db # 统一 SQLite 数据库（设置 / Cookie / 自制歌单） ├── .github/workflows/ # GitHub Actions 工作流 ├── .github/scripts/ # GitHub Actions 辅助脚本（Android FFmpeg 下载、注入与校验） ├── screenshots/ # 截图资源 ├── docker-compose.yml # Docker 生产环境配置 (直接拉取镜像) ├── docker-compose.dev.yml # Docker 开发环境配置 (本地构建) ├── Dockerfile # Docker 构建配置 ├── go.mod # Go 模块配置 ├── README.md # 主项目说明 ├── package.bat # 构建Rust桌面程序脚本 ├── package_go.bat # 构建Go桌面程序脚本 ├── package_app.bat # 构建Android移动应用脚本 ├── package_ios.bat # 构建IOS移动应用脚本 ├── run.bat # Go Music DL - 启动脚本 (Windows) └── run.sh # Go Music DL - 启动脚本 (Linux/macOS) ``` ## 技术栈 * **核心库**: [music-lib](https://github.com/guohuiyuan/music-lib) - 音乐平台搜索下载 * **CLI 框架**: [Cobra](https://github.com/spf13/cobra) - 命令行工具 * **Web 框架**: [Gin](https://github.com/gin-gonic/gin) - Web 框架 * **TUI 框架**: [Bubble Tea](https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea) - 终端界面 * **桌面框架**: [Tao](https://github.com/tauri-apps/tao) + [Wry](https://github.com/tauri-apps/wry) - 跨平台桌面应用 * **图像处理**: [image](https://github.com/image-rs/image) - 图标处理 ### 桌面应用架构 桌面应用采用前后端分离架构： * **前端**: Rust + Tao/Wry - 负责窗口管理、WebView 渲染和进程管理 * **后端**: Go 二进制 - 嵌入到桌面应用中，提供 Web 服务和音乐功能 * **通信**: HTTP 本地服务 - 前后端通过 `http://127.0.0.1:37777` 通信 详细说明请参考 [desktop/README.md](desktop/README.md) ## 贡献 欢迎提交 Issue 或 Pull Request。 ## 许可证 本项目遵循 GNU Affero General Public License v3.0（AGPL-3.0）。详情见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 ## 致敬 感谢以下优秀的开源项目： * **下载库**: [0xHJK/music-dl](https://github.com/0xHJK/music-dl) - 音乐下载库 * **下载库**: [CharlesPikachu/musicdl](https://github.com/CharlesPikachu/musicdl) - 音乐下载库 * **接口设计参考**: [metowolf/Meting](https://github.com/metowolf/Meting) - 多平台音乐聚合与接口封装 * **无损音乐**: [Suxiaoqinx/Netease_url](https://github.com/Suxiaoqinx/Netease_url) - 网易云音乐 FLAC 无损音乐解析 * **QQ 音乐**: [Suxiaoqinx/qqmusic_flac](https://github.com/Suxiaoqinx/qqmusic_flac) - QQ 音乐 FLAC 解析 * **逐字歌词展示参考**: [chenmozhijin/LDDC](https://github.com/chenmozhijin/LDDC) - 原文 / 译文 / 罗马音逐字歌词的组织与展示思路参考 * **汽水音乐接口参考**: [Zencok/baka-plugins](https://github.com/Zencok/baka-plugins) - 汽水音乐搜索、取流和扫码接口参考 * **汽水音乐整曲方案**: [sodahub-org/sodam](https://github.com/sodahub-org/sodam) - Cookie + 设备指纹 + 签名（调官方客户端 bdms.node）取整曲的完整实现，本项目汽水会员整曲能力的直接源头 ## 免责声明 仅供学习和技术交流使用。下载的音乐资源请在 24 小时内删除。 ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://star-history.dera.page/svg?repos=guohuiyuan/go-music-dl&type=date&legend=top-left)](https://star-history.dera.page/#guohuiyuan/go-music-dl&type=date&legend=top-left)

repositories.description: A modern, cool, sleek music player. made with <3
repositories.readme:
Sleek modern cool music player for android, open source, packed with features and doesn’t collect ur data >_< oh and, still in beta!

> [!WARNING] > This app still on beta!, expect some bugs! reporting it will be useful too!!! --- ## Hhhh-how to install? :3 1. On your phone, open the [latest release](https://github.com/realidkroo/mochy-music/releases/latest). 2. Download the `.apk` that matches your phone. If you are not sure, pick **arm64**, that is almost every phone from the last 8 years. The **universal** one works everywhere but is bigger. 3. Open the downloaded file. Android will ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager, say yes (you can turn it off again after). 4. Open Mochy. You are done, no account needed to start listening. Updating works the same way: install the new apk over the old one and your library stays. > [!TIP] > Only download Mochy from the releases page of this repo. A random mediafire or telegram link could be a modified app, and then your logins would not be safe, pls avoid those > [!BTW] > We support android 7 unofficially. --- ## Some Prview --- # FAQ Q - Is it safe to log in? (read this before signing in) A - Tbh, you never have to log in to use this thing btw. Search, play, lyrics and downloads work without an account. Signing in is only for syncing your YouTube Music library, importing playlists from Spotify / Apple Music / Tidal, and Discord status **How the sign-in works** - Mochy opens the real login page of the service (for example accounts.google.com or open.spotify.com) inside the app. You type your password into **their** page, not into a Mochy form. - After you log in, the app keeps the session token or cookie that the service gives out, so you stay signed in. Your password is not what gets saved. - That session stays on your phone, in the app's private storage. Mochy has no account system of its own and does not run a server that collects logins. - The tokens are meant to be used only to talk to the service you signed in to (for example Spotify's own site to read your playlists). - The app is open source under GPL-3.0 so you do not have to take my word for it, you can always read exactly what it does with them :) Q - Pls add liquid glass A - No, and not now. maybe in form of modules created by someone in the future Q - Monochrome/flac stream doesnt work A - The server down, its on their side not us. use other anvailable sources, join our discord Q - Animation is too slow, can you speed it up? A - You can speed it up on customize page. Q - Official Desktop app? A - Later Q - App too laggy, how to fix? A - Disabling blur will helps Q - Can i contribute? A - Ofc Q - Can you add less spacing for the player A - You can customize it yourself Q - I hate this app, i dont want to use it A - Nobody is forcing you to use this --- ## How to build it yourself You only need this if you want to change the code. If you just want to use the app, use the install steps above. ### What you need - A Mac, Linux or Windows computer with screen - [Android Studio](https://developer.android.com/studio) (latest stable). It brings JDK 21 and the Android SDK with it - Android SDK 36 and NDK `27.0.12077973`. Android Studio offers to download both the first time you open the project - About 10 gb free disk space, the first build downloads a lottt - A phone with USB debugging on, or an emulator. ### Steps ```bash git clone https://github.com/realidkroo/mochy-music.git cd mochy-music ``` 1. Open the folder in Android Studio once and let it finish syncing. This also creates `local.properties` with your SDK path. 2. Build and install on your connected phone: ```bash ./build.sh --debug -i ``` First build takes a while, the next ones are much faster. 3. Or build the apk only and install it by hand. The apk lands in `apk-generated/`: ```bash ./build.sh --debug adb install -r apk-generated/*-debug.apk ``` Handy options (see `./build.sh --help` for all of them): | Command | What it does | |---|---| | `./build.sh --debug -i` | debug build, installs and opens it on your phone | | `./build.sh --release -cc` | release build for arm64 and universal | | `./build.sh -fd --release` | F-Droid flavor, without the self-update permission | | `./build.sh -k` | stops stuck Gradle builds | Use **debug** while you are playing around, it builds much much faster. A debug build installs next to the real app (`com.example.mochy.debug`), so it will not touch your normal install, but it is also a bit slower to run. ### Optional keys Mochy builds fine without these, only the matching feature is switched off. Put them in `local.properties` (it is never committed): ```properties LASTFM_API_KEY=... LASTFM_SECRET=... DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=... ``` Never commit your keys. Libre.fm works without any key. ### If the build fails - `Unresolved reference` or Hilt errors that make no sense: delete the `build/` folders and `.gradle/` and build again. - Stuck or weird Gradle: `./build.sh -k`, then try again. - Wrong Java: make sure Gradle uses JDK 21 (Android Studio → Settings → Build Tools → Gradle → Gradle JDK). - Still stuck? Open an [issue](https://github.com/realidkroo/mochy-music/issues) with the error text. Want to send a fix? Read [CONTRIBUTING](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) first. --- ## How to build module? im working on it wait --- ## Wants to help? bug report? report it on issues! Or read contribute.md there --- ## Disclaimer Mochy is an independent, unofficial project made for personal and educational use. It is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. - Mochy is a fully open source project that is created purely for educationa and personal use. thats why, we dont sell this software, or monetize it. we do not have any intent to add commercial values in the future. thanks! - And were deeply respect the hardwork of artist musicians ajd contwnt creators. without them there is also no mochy: i strongly suggest that you, as user, subscribe to Apple music or youtube premium, to support the creators you listen. I do not intend to hurt creator with this app. - It is **not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by** YouTube, YouTube Music, Google, Spotify, Apple, Last.fm, Shazam, Discord or any other service it can connect to. All names, logos and brands belong to their respective owners. - Mochy does not host, store or distribute any music. Everything is fetched from third-party services when you ask for it, and those services can change or stop working at any time. - You are responsible for how you use the app, including the terms of service of the accounts and services you connect and the copyright laws where you live. - Importing from other services (Spotify, etc.) uses your own account. Don't share your login data or tokens with anyone. - Importing music MAY need your own account with its password. WE'RE NEVER see your password. --- ## These incredible project helped mochy a lot! check them out too :3 - **ViviMusic** by [vivizzz007Z](https://github.com/vivizzz007Z) )[Their repo](https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music)) -- For the base app. This app is a fork from this project. - **Metrolist** by [Mostafa Alagamy](https://github.com/mostafaalagamy) ([Repository](https://github.com/mostafaalagamy/Metrolist)) -- For the base framework. - **SimpMusic** by [maxrave-dev](https://github.com/maxrave-dev) ([Repository](https://github.com/maxrave-dev/SimpMusic)) -- For the lyrics API provider. - **Archivetune** by [Rukamori](https://github.com/rukamori) ([Repository](https://github.com/rukamori/ArchiveTune)) -- For design and architectural inspiration. - **RiMusic / InnerTube** by [fast4x](https://github.com/fast4x) ([Repository](https://github.com/fast4x/RiMusic)) -- For YouTube Music InnerTube API service wrapper. - **LRCLib** by [tranxuanthang](https://github.com/tranxuanthang) ([Repository](https://github.com/tranxuanthang/lrclib) / [Website](https://lrclib.net/)) -- For synchronized LRC lyrics provider integration. - **Monochrome Music** by [monochrome-music](https://github.com/monochrome-music) ([Repository](https://github.com/monochrome-music/monochrome) / ([Website](https://monochrome.st)) -- Flac streams, visit their web, very cool one. - **Auto Eq** ([Web](https://autoeq.app)) -- The equalizer database --- ## Open source APIs mochy talks to!! These are the open source apis and server we get gets its lyrics, streams and data from. They r free for everyone because of these good people, so go give them a star! - **LyricsPlus** by [Ibra Al Tabian](https://github.com/ibratabian17) ([repos](https://github.com/ibratabian17/LyricsPlus)) s - **Better Lyrics API** by [Boidushya](https://github.com/boidushya) ([repos](https://github.com/better-lyrics/api)) - **LRCLIB** by [tranxuanthang](https://github.com/tranxuanthang) ([repos](https://github.com/tranxuanthang/lrclib) / [Website](https://lrclib.net/)) - **SimpMusic Lyrics** by [maxrave-dev](https://github.com/maxrave-dev) ([repos](https://github.com/maxrave-dev/SimpMusic)) --- ## Star History

repositories.name: spotifast
repositories.description: Spotify, native and fast. One lightweight Rust app for your whole library, local playback, and Spotify Connect on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
repositories.readme:
Spotifast

Spotify, native and fast.
A lightweight music app for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

Download · Getting started · User guide · Contribute

Spotifast is a Spotify client written in Rust with [egui](https://www.egui.rs) and [fastframe](https://fastframe.dev), the framework behind a family of native desktop apps. It plays music through [Spotify Soloist](https://spotifast.rocks/soloist/) or the built-in [librespot](https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot) player, and has no browser engine. The interface includes complete [translations for all supported languages](docs/_reference/translating.md#languages-and-coverage). **Playback needs Spotify Premium.** Free accounts can browse and search, but cannot play music through Spotifast. ![Spotifast Home with the playlist library, recommendations, queue, and player visible](docs/screenshot.png)
Watch Spotifast in action https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a5f669ce-b3b7-4f8e-9933-976a78876c7e
[Features](#your-music-on-your-desktop) · [Install](#install) · [First playback](#start-listening) · [Mini player](#the-winamp-mini-player) · [MilkDrop](#music-in-motion) · [Help](#guides-and-help) Since 0.15, setup leads with Spotify's [Soloist player](https://spotifast.rocks/soloist/), with guided key setup, one-time pairing and automatic renewal of expiring builds. New listeners and people updating see this choice once after sign-in on supported platforms. **Use the built-in player** keeps librespot, with Spotifast's EQ, visualizers, local files and full queue editing. The choice is remembered. On Linux with PipeWire, Soloist also supports Spotifast’s EQ and visualizers through a private audio route. [Native audio support](https://spotifast.rocks/soloist/#native-audio) adds EQ and visualizers on macOS 14.2 or newer, and visualizers on Windows 11, including MilkDrop. Windows Soloist playback does not support audible EQ. The Mac route keeps Soloist at full volume after redirecting its output, then applies Spotifast’s volume after the visualizers, including mute. Phone volume changes adjust that output level; Spotify’s indicator returns to 100%. Windows visuals keep their level as Soloist’s volume falls and stop only when it is muted. When enabled, Soloist appears as **This computer**; settings show the controls that apply to it. Turning it off restores the built-in player's preferences. While Soloist starts and its account is verified, the Spotify loading screen shows **Verifying Soloist…** and waits to accept playback commands. Setup takes three steps, and ends with choosing the named device in Spotify, with the built-in player available as a quiet alternative below the card. If Soloist stops later, a banner over the app says so while Spotifast restarts it, and offers **Try again** if that does not work. **Settings → Spotify Soloist → Spotify access** connects the separate Spotify session for Made for you, listening activity and Spotify lyrics without changing players. ## Your music, on your desktop | Feature | What you can do | |---|---| | **Library and search** | Browse playlists, Liked Songs, albums, artists, and podcasts. Discover upcoming albums on artist pages and open their countdown to pre-save. Search the catalogue and edit playlists you own. Copy a song's link, title, or artists from its menu. | | **Local files** | Play the local files your playlists list from a folder you choose in Settings, at any sample rate. Names show spaces and accents correctly, including in cached playlists. | | **Lyrics** | Spotify lyrics when the playback session is signed in, with LRCLIB as fallback. Temporary LRCLIB overloads retry and try search; older cached lyrics remain available during outages. | | **Spotify Connect** | Play on this computer or control playback on your other devices, including Google Cast speakers and groups. Cast devices appear as they are discovered; frequently and recently chosen outputs rise to the top. Remote volume keeps your chosen level while Spotify updates. | | **Queue** | Add songs to the queue, or choose **Play next** to put a song or selection first when playing on this computer. | | **Themes** | Choose light, dark, system appearance, or custom colours, with one theme for light mode and one for dark mode that switch with the system. On Omarchy, follow your desktop theme. | | **Desktop controls** | Use keyboard shortcuts and media keys. Keep music playing from the tray when supported by your desktop and settings, and start Spotifast with your computer, with its window or in the tray. | | **Winamp mini player** | Use classic skins with an equalizer, playlist, and animated sound displays. | | **MilkDrop** | Watch music-reactive visuals in a separate window or full screen. See platform availability below. | ## Install | Platform | Installation | |---|---| | **macOS** | `brew install --cask crmne/tap/spotifast`, or [download the Mac app](https://spotifast.rocks/download/#macos). | | **Arch Linux** | `yay -S spotifast-bin` | | **Windows** | The installer or a portable ZIP, for x64 and ARM, from the [Download page](https://spotifast.rocks/download/#windows). | | **Debian, Ubuntu** | The [DEB package](https://spotifast.rocks/download/#debian-and-ubuntu), then `sudo apt install ./spotifast_*.deb` | | **Fedora** | The [RPM package](https://spotifast.rocks/download/#fedora), then `sudo dnf install ./spotifast-*.rpm` | | **Other Linux** | Find Flatpak, AppImage, Nix, and other options on the [Download page](https://spotifast.rocks/download/#linux). | | **From source** | Follow [Build from source](https://spotifast.rocks/getting-started/#build-from-source) for dependencies and commands. | ## Start listening 1. Register Spotifast with Spotify, as the sign-in screen shows: in the [Spotify developer dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard), click **Create app**, Spotify's name for this registration, with the redirect URI `http://127.0.0.1:8989/login` and **Web API** ticked. It takes about two minutes and gives you a Client ID. Spotify requires Premium on the account that registers, so a Free account can't do this step itself. [Getting started](https://spotifast.rocks/getting-started/#make-a-spotify-app) has the steps. 2. Paste the Client ID into Spotifast and choose **Sign in with Spotify**. Approve access in your browser, then return to the app to see your library. 3. To listen on this computer, open the device menu in the bottom player bar and choose **Set up playback here**, also available in Settings. 4. Complete the separate playback approval in your browser. Your computer appears as a Spotify Connect device named **Spotifast**. Library access and local playback have separate approvals. Spotifast remembers both using your computer's protected storage. See [Getting started](https://spotifast.rocks/getting-started/) for the full walkthrough and [How it connects](https://spotifast.rocks/how-it-connects/) for the details. ## The Winamp mini player A classic look for your music, with Winamp 2 `.wsz` and Windows Media Player `.wmz` skins, an equalizer, a playlist, and animated sound displays. Switch with **Ctrl+M** (**Cmd+Shift+M** on macOS), the shrink button, or Settings. The spectrum analyser and oscilloscope also work in the collapsed title bar.

[Explore the mini player](https://spotifast.rocks/winamp/), including skins, window sizes, controls, and the return to the main player. ## Music in motion MilkDrop reacts to music playing on this computer, with more than 10,000 presets downloaded on first use. Open it from the visualiser button, Settings, or the mini player's **V** menu. ![MilkDrop visualiser displaying coloured concentric patterns in Spotifast](docs/assets/images/milkdrop-poster.jpg) Included on **Linux**, **macOS**, and **Windows Intel/AMD** builds. It is not included in the Windows on ARM download. [Read the MilkDrop guide](https://spotifast.rocks/milkdrop/) for presets, controls, and fullscreen mode. ## Guides and help The complete guide lives at **[spotifast.rocks](https://spotifast.rocks/)**. | You want to… | Read | |---|---| | Sign in, set up playback, or configure themes, fonts, and proxies | [Getting started](https://spotifast.rocks/getting-started/) | | Learn shortcuts, command-line controls, and updates | [Everyday use](https://spotifast.rocks/using-spotifast/) | | Check storage sizes, clear cached audio and find stored files | [Settings and files](https://spotifast.rocks/settings-and-files/) | | Understand scrolling performance and reduce loading delays | [Make it even faster](https://spotifast.rocks/make-it-even-faster/) | | Fix "Spotify refused the audio key" or "Spotify is being slow" | [When something goes wrong](https://spotifast.rocks/troubleshooting/) | | Understand what is stored and sent | [Privacy](https://spotifast.rocks/privacy/) · [How it connects](https://spotifast.rocks/how-it-connects/) | | Check Spotify and librespot limitations | [What Spotify allows](https://spotifast.rocks/what-spotify-allows/) | | Is it safe for my account? | [Account safety](https://spotifast.rocks/what-is-spotifast/#account-safety) | | Report a bug or propose a feature | Read [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md), then use the [issue forms](https://github.com/crmne/spotifast/issues/new/choose). | ## Contributing Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening an issue or pull request. To look at the interface without a Spotify account, run: ```sh cargo run --features demo -- --demo ``` Translations live in `assets/i18n/`; see [Translating Spotifast](docs/_reference/translating.md). Release packaging is described in [PACKAGING.md](PACKAGING.md). ## More native apps **Want WhatsApp just as fast and native?** [ZapFast](https://zapfast.rocks) is Spotifast's sibling. Both are built on [fastframe](https://fastframe.dev). ## Spotify Connect updates With local playback enabled, Spotify pushes changes from other devices over Spotifast's existing Connect session. Playback changes trigger a refresh. Volume-only changes appear directly for the active playback device without an extra request; an unconfirmed volume change made in Spotifast takes precedence. Push-triggered refreshes are at least a second apart and wait for a pending playback read to finish. Changes received during that read are folded into one follow-up. Connect pushes are ignored when this computer is the active device both before and after; position-only updates cause no requests. Regular polling remains the fallback. ## Sonos playback Sonos speakers use the Spotify Connect session for playback control. Enable local playback first, then select the speaker in the device picker. ## Acknowledgements Spotifast uses [librespot](https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot), [egui](https://www.egui.rs), [fastframe](https://fastframe.dev), the [Inter](https://rsms.me/inter/) typeface (OFL), and [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) icons (ISC). Spotifast is an independent project and is not affiliated with Spotify. Spotify is a trademark of Spotify AB. Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). ## Star history

repositories.readme:
# Mailflare A self-hosted alternative to Google Workspace. Setup **custom domain Emails**, **Calendar, Drive, Booking** and **built-in AI agents**. Run it on Cloudflare or Docker. Send and receive with Cloudflare, Resend or Amazon SES. Store files in R2, Backblaze B2 or AWS S3. Use D1, Postgres, MySQL or Turso for the database. [![Deploy to Cloudflare](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/button)](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/hieunc229/mailflare) ## Screenshots

Inbox
Domains
Mailboxes

Calendar
Booking
Drive
### Sponsors   Want to support Mailflare? [Become a sponsor](https://store.paymug.co/buy/mailflare-sponsor). ## Features ### Apps - **Email**: Custom domain mailboxes, personal or shared, with access you control. Send and receive with Cloudflare Email, Resend or Amazon SES. - **Routing rules**: Store, forward, reject or sort incoming mail. - **Calendar**: Repeating events with time zones. Attendees get email invitations. - **Booking**: Share a public link so anyone can book a free time on your calendar. - **Drive**: Store and share files. - **AI agents**: Search mail, draft replies and manage events. Connect other AI tools over MCP. ### Technical - **Databases**: Cloudflare D1 (default), PostgreSQL, MySQL, Turso / libSQL, or a local SQLite file. Set `DATABASE_URL` to switch. Works with Supabase, Neon, PlanetScale, TiDB and more. See [Databases](docs/databases.md). - **File storage**: Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2 or AWS S3. - **Hosting**: Cloudflare Workers or a single Docker container. - **Admin**: Users, API keys, webhooks, audit logs and backups. - **Import**: Bring in mail from IMAP, Gmail Takeout, `.eml` and `.mbox` files. Mailflare currently supports 34 languages, including English, Português (Brasil), Português (Portugal), Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Nederlands, Polski, Українська, Русский, Türkçe, 中文（简体）, 日本語, 한국어, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, हिन्दी, বাংলা, मराठी, తెలుగు, தமிழ், ગુજરાતી, ಕನ್ನಡ, മലയാളം, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ, සිංහල, Kiswahili, Hausa, plus العربية, اردو and فارسی (right-to-left). ## Cost You can receive and send mail for free. - **Receiving**: Cloudflare Email Routing is free. - **Sending**: Use the free tier of Resend (3,000 emails a month) or Amazon SES. Cloudflare's own sending needs the $5/month Paid Worker plan. New Amazon SES accounts start in a sandbox. Ask AWS for production access to lift it. Prices change, so check [Resend](https://resend.com/pricing), [Amazon SES](https://aws.amazon.com/ses/pricing/) and [Cloudflare](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/). ## Deploy 1. **Deploy the app.** Click **Deploy to Cloudflare**. Keep the app name `mailflare`, or it will break. 2. **Finish setup.** Open the app at `/setup` and create your admin account. 3. **Connect a domain.** Add a domain from the same Cloudflare account, then create your first mailbox. > **`CF_TOKEN` is required.** Create a scoped [Cloudflare API token](https://github.com/hieunc229/mailflare/issues/24#issuecomment-5523686105) with these permissions: > > - All accounts: Email Sending:Edit, DNS Settings:Edit, Email Routing Addresses:Edit > - All zones: DNS Settings:Edit, Email Routing Rules:Edit, Zone Settings:Edit, DNS:Edit More options: [deployment guide](docs/deployment.md). ### Deploy with an AI agent Paste this into an AI agent that has terminal access (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and similar): ```text Install Mailflare for me from https://github.com/hieunc229/mailflare on my Cloudflare account. 1. Read README.md, docs/deployment.md and wrangler.jsonc first. 2. Ask me for my Cloudflare account ID and two API tokens, using a secret input: a deploy token (for Wrangler) and a runtime token (the Worker secret CF_TOKEN). Never print them, commit them, or pass them as command arguments. 3. Keep the Worker name exactly "mailflare". Create or reuse the D1 database "mailflare", the R2 bucket "mailflare-raw", and the queues "mailflare-inbound", "mailflare-outbound" and "mailflare-agent". 4. Install dependencies, run `npm run deploy`, and set CF_TOKEN as a Worker secret. Do not run remote database migrations yourself. The /setup page does that. 5. Give me the app URL and anything I still need to do. I will open /setup, create the admin account and connect my domain. ``` Token permissions and more options: [deployment guide](docs/deployment.md#deploy-with-an-ai-coding-agent). ### Self-host with Docker Runs as one container on any server, with SQLite and local files. ```bash cp .env.docker.example .env.docker docker compose up -d --build ``` See [self-hosting](docs/self-hosting.md). ## Local development ```bash cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars npm install npm run db:migrate:local npm run dev ``` Add your Cloudflare credentials to `.dev.vars`, then open [localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000). Run `npm run db:seed` to load sample data. - `npm run build`: build the Worker - `npm run deploy`: build and deploy - `npm run lint`: lint and type check A schema change needs a migration for each database type. See [Databases](docs/databases.md#migrations). ## Documentation - [Deployment and configuration](docs/deployment.md) - [Databases](docs/databases.md) - [Sending and receiving providers](docs/providers.md) - [API and integrations](docs/api.md) - [Email assistant and MCP](docs/email-assistant-and-mcp.md) - [Adding a language](docs/localization.md) - [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md) ## License See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
